questions.question_english: 49. What is the full official duration for playing/singing the complete version of the National Anthem of India?
questions.explanation_english: The full official rendering of the National Anthem of India, Jana Gana Mana, takes approximately 52 seconds to perform. Composed originally in Bengali by Rabindranath Tagore, its first stanza was adopted as the National Anthem by the Constituent Assembly on January 24, 1950. On specific ceremonial occasions, a shortened version consisting of the first and last lines is played in 20 seconds.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। भारत के राष्ट्रीय गान, जन गण मन, का पूरा आधिकारिक संस्करण गाने में लगभग 52 सेकंड का समय लगता है। इसे मूल रूप से रवींद्रनाथ ठाकुर द्वारा बांग्ला में लिखा गया था, और इसका पहला पद 24 जनवरी 1950 को संविधान सभा द्वारा राष्ट्रीय गान के रूप में अपनाया गया था। विशेष समारोहों पर, पहले और अंतिम पंक्तियों का संक्षिप्त संस्करण 20 सेकंड में बजाया जाता है।

questions.question_english: 29. The Abel Prize, awarded annually, recognizes outstanding achievements in which discipline?
questions.explanation_english: The Abel Prize is a prestigious international distinction awarded annually to recognize extraordinary scientific achievements in mathematics. Established by the Parliament of Norway in 2002, the prize honors the legacy of Norwegian mathematician Niels Henrik Abel. Often referred to as the equivalent of the Nobel Prize for mathematics, it comes with a monetary award and is presented by the Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters.

questions.question_english: 51. Who was the first recipient of the Param Vir Chakra, India’s highest wartime gallantry award?
questions.explanation_english: Major Somnath Sharma of the 4th Battalion, Kumaon Regiment, was the first recipient of the Param Vir Chakra, India’s highest military decoration. He was awarded the honor posthumously for exceptional bravery and leadership displayed during the Battle of Badgam in November 1947. Despite suffering heavy injuries, he valiantly defended the Srinagar airfield against invading tribal raiders during the Indo-Pakistani War.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। मेजर सोमनाथ शर्मा, 4वीं बटालियन, कुमाऊं रेजिमेंट के थे, और उन्हें परम वीर चक्र, भारत का सर्वोच्च सैन्य पुरस्कार, प्राप्त करने वाले पहले व्यक्ति के रूप में जाना जाता है। उन्हें यह सम्मान बाद में दिया गया था, जो कि नवंबर 1947 में बडगाम की लड़ाई के दौरान उनकी असाधारण बहादुरी और नेतृत्व के लिए था। उन्होंने भारी चोटों के बावजूद, कश्मीर एयरफील्ड की रक्षा की थी।

17. How do peacetime gallantry awards differ from wartime gallantry awards in India?
(1) Peacetime awards are conferred exclusively upon civilian citizens, whereas wartime awards are conferred strictly upon serving defense personnel.
(2) Peacetime awards recognize bravery away from the battlefield, whereas wartime awards recognize bravery in the presence of the enemy.
(3) Wartime awards are personally presented by the Prime Minister of India, whereas peacetime awards are presented by the Chief.
questions.explanation_english: Peacetime awards recognize bravery away from the battlefield, whereas wartime awards recognize bravery in the presence of the enemy. Gallantry awards in India are categorized into wartime and peacetime decorations based on the operational environment. Wartime awards, such as the Param Vir Chakra, Maha Vir Chakra, and Vir Chakra, recognize acts of conspicuous bravery performed in the presence of the enemy during war. Peacetime awards, including the Ashoka Chakra, Kirti Chakra, and Shaurya Chakra, honor acts of bravery in non-combat situations.

questions.explanation_english: The Flag Code of India regulates the specifications, display, and usage of the National Flag. According to these statutory guidelines, the National Flag must always be rectangular in shape, maintaining a strict ratio of three to two regarding its length versus height. questions.question_english: 64. Which of the following statements regarding the Sahitya Akademi is INCORRECT?
options_english: It was officially inaugurated by the Government of India in March 1954.
It awards only works translated from foreign languages into Sanskrit.
It functions as a fully autonomous national organization under the Ministry of Culture.
questions.explanation_english: The Sahitya Akademi was inaugurated by the Government of India in March 1954 and functions as an autonomous national organization dedicated to promoting Indian literature under the Ministry of Culture. It officially recognizes 24 languages, presenting annual awards for outstanding original literary creations in each language. Its scope is broad and not restricted merely to foreign language translations into Sanskrit, making the statement that it only awards works translated from foreign languages into Sanskrit incorrect.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। साहित्य अकादमी का उद्घाटन मार्च 1954 में भारत सरकार द्वारा किया गया था और यह संस्कृति मंत्रालय के तहत भारतीय साहित्य को बढ़ावा देने के लिए एक स्वायत्त राष्ट्रीय संगठन के रूप में कार्य करती है। यह आधिकारिक रूप से 24 भाषाओं को मान्यता देती है, प्रत्येक भाषा में उत्कृष्ट मौलिक साहित्यिक रचनाओं के लिए वार्षिक पुरस्कार प्रदान करती है। इसका दायरा व्यापक है और केवल विदेशी भाषाओं से संस्कृत में अनुवादित कार्यों तक सीमित नहीं है, जिससे यह कथन गलत है कि यह केवल विदेशी भाषाओं से अनुवादित कार्यों को पुरस्कार देती है।

questions.question_english: 48. National Unity Day (Rashtriya Ekta Diwas) is celebrated in India on October 31 each year to commemorate the birth anniversary of which leader?
questions.explanation_english: National Unity Day, or Rashtriya Ekta Diwas, is observed every year across India on October 31. The observance was introduced by the Government of India in 2014 to commemorate the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. Known as the Iron Man of India, Patel played a pivotal role in unifying over 500 princely states into the Indian Union following independence in 1947.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। राष्ट्रीय एकता दिवस, या राष्ट्रिया एकता दिवस, हर साल 31 अक्टूबर को भारत में मनाया जाता है। यह अवलोकन 2014 में भारत सरकार द्वारा सरदार वल्लभभाई पटेल की जयंती के उपलक्ष्य में शुरू किया गया था। पटेल, जिन्हें भारत का आयरन मैन कहा जाता है, ने 1947 में स्वतंत्रता के बाद 500 से अधिक रियासतों को भारतीय संघ में एकीकृत करने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई।
questions.topic: Awards, Honours, and Miscellaneous General Knowledge
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: National Unity Day, or Rashtriya Ekta Diwas, is observed every year across India on October 31. The observance was introduced by the Government of India in 2014 to commemorate the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.

questions.question_english: 14. Which of the following represents the correct chronological sequence of the conferral of Bharat Ratna upon these eminent Prime Ministers?
options_english: Jawaharlal Nehru → Lal Bahadur Shastri → Indira Gandhi → Rajiv Gandhi
Lal Bahadur Shastri → Jawaharlal Nehru → Rajiv Gandhi → Indira Gandhi
Jawaharlal Nehru → Indira Gandhi → Lal Bahadur Shastri → Rajiv Gandhi
Indira Gandhi → Jawaharlal Nehru → Lal Bahadur Shastri → Rajiv Gandhi
questions.explanation_english: The conferral of the Bharat Ratna upon these Prime Ministers followed a specific historical timeline. Jawaharlal Nehru was awarded the civilian honor in 1955. Lal Bahadur Shastri received it posthumously in 1966, becoming the first recipient to be honored posthumously. Indira Gandhi was conferred the award in 1971, and Rajiv Gandhi received the honor posthumously in 1991 following his assassination.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। भारत रत्न का सम्मान इन प्रधानमंत्रियों को एक विशिष्ट ऐतिहासिक समयरेखा के अनुसार दिया गया। जवाहरलाल नेहरू को 1955 में यह नागरिक सम्मान मिला। लाल बहादुर शास्त्री को 1966 में मरणोपरांत यह सम्मान मिला, जिससे वह मरणोपरांत सम्मानित होने वाले पहले व्यक्ति बने। इंदिरा गांधी को 1971 में यह पुरस्कार मिला, और राजीव गांधी को 1991 में उनके हत्या के बाद मरणोपरांत यह सम्मान मिला।
